deadline.value: Apply by January 1st to receive full consideration for admission and graduate assistant support.
deadline.quote: To receive full consideration for admission and graduate assistant support beginning in the Fall term, please apply by January 1st.

gre_general.value: GRE general test scores not required.
gre_general.quote: We don't require applicants to report GRE scores from the general test or subject test. Students who submit applications without GRE scores will be given equal consideration.

gre_subject.value: GRE Mathematics subject test scores not required.
gre_subject.quote: We don't require applicants to report GRE scores from the general test or subject test. Students who submit applications without GRE scores will be given equal consideration.

supervisor.value: Prospective students encouraged to reach out to potential advisors via email.
supervisor.quote: We emphasize that, to become a competitive applicant, you need to identify and begin forming a relationship with a potential advisor. We encourage prospective students to reach out to potential advisors, via email, to learn more about their work and how it might align with your research interests.

funding.value: All admitted graduate students offered GTA or GRA support covering tuition and living stipend.
funding.quote: Yes, all graduate students admitted into our graduate program are offered support through a graduate teaching assistnatship (GTA) or a graduate research assistantship (GRA). Assistantships cover the cost of tuition and provide a stipend to cover the cost of living in Blacksburg, VA.

entry_route.value: Regular admission requires an earned bachelor's degree with a minimum 3.0 GPA.
entry_route.quote: Regular admission to a graduate degree is open to applicants whose grade point average (GPA) meets or exceeds the 3.00 required by the Graduate School for the last half of the credits earned for the undergraduate (bachelor’s) degree, and whose academic background meets the requirements of the admitting academic unit.
